units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data aluminum_lammps.data

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe etotal press vol

# NPT Quenching
fix 1 all npt temp 2000 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0 drag 1.0
run 20000
unfix 1

# NPT Relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0 drag 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NVT Relaxation
fix 3 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000
unfix 3

# Output final density
variable mass equal mass(all)
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal v_mass/v_volume
print "Final density: ${density} g/cm^3""}
